Update to my Yeti build: The build went easy enough with no major issues.

After test driving it, it was apparent that the servo horn was inadequate for the huge tires. The servo is a HiTec 35646W HS-5646WP and quickly ripped though the plastic horn. Added the Axial AX30836 Aluminum Servo Horn 24T and Castle Creations CC Bec 10A 6S Switching Regulator.

I think the shocks are also not enough for this heavy kit and will try some stiffer springs soon.
